note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; only the alate is recorded, based on a single paratype in the AMNH; soldier and worker are not described; synonymy, literature citations, distribution and figure numbers are omitted.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown, paler around fontanelle; postclypeus, antennae and legs brown; pronotum paler than head capsule but darker than postclypeus; abdominal tergites slightly paler than head capsule, sternites paler than tergites; wings light brown. Pilosity of head and body dense. Head capsule subcircular, much wider than the length to the base of the mandibles; length to apex of labrum 2.70 mm, length to base of mandibles 1.88 mm, width including compound eyes 2.68 mm; frons distinctly sloping forwards. Fontanelle minute, raised. Compound eyes large, wide, oval, maximum diameter 0.80 mm, minimum diameter 0.70 mm, adjacent to lower margin of head, eye–lower margin distance 0.08 mm. Ocelli large, broadly oval, long diameter 0.40 mm, short diameter 0.275 mm; close to compound eye, eye–ocellus distance far less than their short diameter, eye–ocellus distance 0.080 mm, ocellus–antenna distance 0.20 mm. Antennae broken, more than 17 segments visible, not more than 20 according to Walker (1853); segments 3 and 5 subequal in length, segment 4 slightly longer. Postclypeus extremely inflated, half as long as wide, 0.50 mm long, 1.05 mm wide. Labrum broadly lingulate, 0.80 mm long, 0.88 mm wide. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal, narrower than head including compound eyes, 1.30 mm long, 2.40 mm wide; anterior margin slightly raised, wavy and distinctly notched at middle; sides slightly narrowed and slightly incurved; posterior margin weakly convex, slightly incurved at middle. Posterior margins of meso- and metanotum broadly incurved. Wings long, wing membrane glabrous; radial sector trace separating from radius slightly before the middle, forewing with wing scales 27.93 mm long, wing scales 1.43 mm long.
